issue (high): 🟠 **Chrome dispatch never passes `--record-video`** **(blocking)**

This row promises a `.gif` per Chrome spec, but `runner.md` (unchanged) still says Chrome cannot record and its `Mode: --all --auto-capture` line omits the flag `aw-tester-chrome` records under.

issue (medium): 🟡 **`SCREENCAST_TTS` runs backticks in narration text** **(non-blocking)**

Double quotes from `JSON.stringify` do not stop `sh` from expanding them: a `say` line of ``Click `touch PWNED` now`` created a `PWNED` file in a test run. Pass the values via the environment.

```js
const cmd = tpl.replaceAll('{text}', '"$SCREENCAST_TEXT"').replaceAll('{out}', '"$SCREENCAST_OUT"');
return spawnSync('sh', ['-c', cmd], { env: { ...process.env, SCREENCAST_TEXT: text, SCREENCAST_OUT: out } }).status === 0 && fs.existsSync(out);
```

<sup>`pr-reviewer` · commit `51487ad`</sup>
